## History

Following a severe illness that [Anne](../character/anne.md) experienced after Shirley's birth, [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) mothered the baby boy with passionate tenderness. Shirley was later taken by [Susan](../character/susan.md) to her brother's home for three months while his parents were away. At six years old, Shirley lived at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) with his family, where [Susan](../character/susan.md) continued to watch over him.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P17](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0017), +100 more_
